approaches.title: Dyadic symmetric midpoint subdivision
approaches.outcome: Explicit proper-space construction defeats automatic consistency; the space still has a linear consistent bicombing.
approaches.proved: Reversible conical tent bicombing and dyadic consistency defect 1/2.
approaches.remaining_gap: Need a better midpoint selection or additional compatibility.

approaches.title: Finite harmonic midpoint meshes
approaches.outcome: Scoped positive theorem on every complete space.
approaches.proved: Weighted contraction, unique midpoint strings, geodesic/conical interpolation, cross-mesh block restriction identity.
approaches.remaining_gap: Fixed-mesh iterative convergence is not convergence as mesh size tends to infinity.

approaches.title: Compactness and infinite-mesh limits
approaches.outcome: Precise conditional convergence theorem; no unconditional limit proved.
approaches.proved: Complete Banach example has noncompact midpoint set; whole-sequence pointwise mesh convergence gives consistent conical limit.
approaches.remaining_gap: Cross-mesh compatibility and unrestricted conical estimate; properness alone does not settle the question.

approaches.title: Medial midpoint algebra
approaches.proved: A symmetric conical medial midpoint on a complete space induces a reversible consistent conical bicombing.
approaches.remaining_gap: Mediality does not follow from conicality; explicit defect 1/4.

approaches.title: Completion and uniqueness reductions
approaches.outcome: Proved extension and elementary solved subclasses; no reduction of unrestricted problem.
approaches.proved: Conical bicombings extend to completions preserving any existing consistency; uniquely geodesic and linearly convex cases affirmative.
approaches.remaining_gap: A replacement bicombing on the completion need not have verified invariance of the original space.
